title: Request access to a shared mailbox
symptom: User wants access to the department's shared mailbox
user_description: I've joined the support team and need to see the shared support mailbox. Can you add me please?

options.text: Give him the mailbox owner's password
options.why: Passwords must never be shared. Access should be given to him directly with his own account.

options.text: Grant full access to the whole department
options.why: Gives more access than needed. Each person should only get what their job requires.

options.text: Confirm the mailbox owner or manager approves, then add the permission he needs, such as read, send as or send on behalf
options.why: Approval confirms the request is genuine, and adding permissions to his own account keeps a record of who did what. Choosing only the permission needed follows least privilege.

options.text: Forward the mailbox's messages to his personal email
options.why: Sends company information outside company systems, which is a security and privacy problem.

hints: Who owns the decision about who may read this mailbox?
Should one person ever use another person's login?
How much access does he actually need?
real_world_tip: Tell the user the new permission may take a little while to appear in Outlook. It is a common follow-up call.
